imagery: Microsoft Planetary Computer sentinel-1-rtc (Catalyst RTC of ESA Sentinel-1 GRD), CC-BY-4.0
limitations: Radar change is not confirmed damage; irrigation, harvest, planting and soil moisture also change backscatter.
Crop types inside each class are unknown; the survey predates the typhoon.
The control interval is one 12-day window; ordinary change varies through the season.

flattened_or_flooded.imagery: NASA/ASF NISAR L2 GCOV, descending orbit 061 frames 076/077 and ascending orbit 039 frame 013
flattened_or_flooded.rule: HH per-parcel median drop beyond what an ordinary 12 days produces; low = 3 dB, high = 2 dB
flattened_or_flooded.note: The 2 dB figure comes mostly from the descending pass, where the same parcels read ~0.4 dB darker overall than on the ascending pass; treat it as an upper bound.
